---
title: "NQC Probs"
format: html
---

Load in packages and read in data:

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(tidyverse)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
tbl_pointer <- tbl(con, "read_parquet('CAISO_dam_big.parquet')")
nqc <- list(
  `2023` = readxl::read_excel("NQC_2023.xls", sheet = "2023 NQC List"),
  `2024` = readxl::read_excel("NQC_2024_sorted.xlsx"),
  `2025` = readxl::read_excel("NQC_2025.xlsx", sheet = "2025 NQC List"),
  `2026` = readxl::read_excel("NQC_2026.xlsx", sheet = "2026 NQC List")
) |>
  imap_dfr(\(x, year) {
    x |>
      select(`Generator Name`:DEC) |>
      pivot_longer(JAN:DEC, names_to = "month", values_to = "capacity") |>
      mutate(year = year, .before = month)
  })
```

Get max capacity for each month, each id:

```{r}
observed_max <- tbl_pointer |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, mo = month(as.Date(STARTTIME))) |>
  filter(!is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA), RESOURCE_TYPE == "GENERATOR") |>
  slice_max(n = 1, order_by = SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, mo, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA) |>
  collect()
```

Compare observed max capacity to NQC:

```{r}
check_capacity <- function(id, obs_max, month, nqc_data) {
  # pull month column of NQC data
  nqc_month <- tibble(
    nqc_data$`Generator Name`,
    nqc_data[str_to_upper(month.abb[month])]
  )
  names(nqc_month) <- c("generator", "capacity")

  # filter to generators with max capacities greater than observed max
  nqc_month |>
    filter(capacity >= obs_max) |>
    mutate(prob = 1 / n(), id = id, month = month)
}

check_capacity(952796, 880, 6, nqc)
```

Repeat for all ids:

```{r}
check_probs <- function(obs_max_df) {
  obs_max_df |>
    pmap(\(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, mo, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA) {
      check_capacity(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, mo, nqc)
    }) |>
    list_rbind()
}

test_df <- tibble(
  RESOURCEBID_SEQ = c(952796, 525442),
  mo = c(6, 2),
  SCH_BID_XAXISDATA = c(880, 120)
)

check_probs(test_df)
```
